Grandfather of murder victim dies after grandson's death

The grandfather of Ketan Agarwal, who was murdered, has died. Devi Chand Agarwal passed away in a Pune hospital following a heart surgery. His death comes shortly after his grandson Ketan's murder, a case in which Ketan's parents, Siya and Chetan, are reportedly involved. The family had previously experienced the death of another grandson.
